svg.title: Escola Monte, Monday, 9.05
svg.desc: A yellow four-storey language school on a steep Lisbon street, open at one side to show a reception desk with a queue, a classroom above it, and a cafe next door with tables outside.

g.text: Fourteen things to find. One of the cats has a name tag, and you can read it.
reception - Ana, and three people waiting
the top of the street, a tram
